# Dainty Dazzle

> Fine, handcrafted jewelry designed to reflect the beauty within.

Dainty Dazzle (brand name: Lumiere) is an editorial, high-fashion jewelry storefront offering delicate necklaces, earrings, rings, and bracelets in 14k gold, rose gold, and sterling silver.

## Collections

- [Necklaces](/collections/necklaces): Chains, pendants, and chokers for bare skin.
- [Earrings](/collections/earrings): Studs, huggies, and drops for every day.
- [Rings](/collections/rings): Thin bands, signets, and stackable styles.
- [Bracelets](/collections/bracelets): Chains, cuffs, and cord bracelets.
- [New Arrivals](/collections/new-arrivals): The latest additions.
